# voipms_phonebook_group (Data Source)

Reads a phonebook group by id or `name` (`getPhonebookGroups`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_phonebook_group" "spam" {
  name = "Spam"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Phonebook group id.
- `name` (String) Group name.

### Read-Only

- `members` (String) Comma-separated phonebook entry ids.
